rationale: winner not established. The project-exception option is assessed only as a possible candidate, not as a recommendation or authorization. Its direct-IAP architecture has capability support and avoids the incremental forwarding-rule charge, but E3 compares cost only, not the top-priority owner-only protection. No COMPARATIVE evidence establishes a P1 advantage, and owner OAuth and browser acceptance remain unknown. Policy-administrator execution and explicit approval are also outstanding. The external-lb rival preserves inherited ingress policy but adds a forwarding-rule charge above the assumed USD 10 planning target before other charges and also lacks approval and browser acceptance.
separating_test: Obtain approval for a route and its required policy or cost change, complete external-owner OAuth setup, then verify signed-out login, owner login, non-owner and forged-header denial, endpoint restrictions, Gradio queue/stream behavior, and persistence. Assess both routes against the same P1 checks and compare actual incremental cost and policy scope before establishing a preference.
